$comment: workhub-owned metadata about the plugins in marketplace.json: which ones a vault cannot work without, and the scope each is installed at. Claude Code does not read this file — the app's Plugins tab does, because 'required vs optional' exists nowhere else in machine-readable form (docs/plugins.md states it in prose). Deliberately carries no version/description/author: plugin.json is the single source for those (T-0221). Every plugin in marketplace.json must appear here exactly once, and vice versa; src/lib/plugin-catalog.test.ts fails CI when the two drift.
